messages.subject: Crosstalk Samples do not work
parts: I have seen Crosstalk and attempted to run the examples I have seen.  However, none of the examples seem to work.  I have verified the widgets I am using have imported the Crosstalk library.  I have copied the code exactly, as presented but still it would not work.  I found on the latest plotly release you need to use ~ instead of $ when referencing a vector in a dataframe.  Once I have done that I could get the example which is using to 2 plotly scatters with a bar chart to partially work.  When selecting points in the scatter on the right the associated points on the left would highlight.  The reverse would not work and the bar chart never reacted to anything.   Does Crosstalk only work in the lab?  Is it possible to get an actual working example?
